SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(closure_id AS VARCHAR) a, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) b, closure_type c, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) f FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nontrading', CAST(calendar_date AS VARCHAR), holiday_name, CAST(is_public_holiday AS VARCHAR), CAST(is_trading_day AS VARCHAR), fiscal_period_label, CAST(fiscal_week AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND (NOT is_trading_day OR is_public_holiday)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'days', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(calendar_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR), '', '' FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.region,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS per_day, ctl.ctl_net, ss.net_sales-ctl.ctl_net AS gap
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctl ON ctl.store_id=ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, SUM(f.net_amount) sold, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) nrl
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE st.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT r.return_date d, SUM(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key WHERE st.store_id=116 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT business_date d, net_sales_before_returns b, returns_net rn, net_sales ns, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=116 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21')
SELECT c.d, s.sold, s.n, s.nd, s.nrl, r.ret, c.b, c.rn, c.ns, s.sold-c.b diff_sold FROM c LEFT JOIN s USING(d) LEFT JOIN r USING(d) ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS (
 SELECT f.*, st.store_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) c
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21')
SELECT store_id, c, count(*) n, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) nl, sum(net_amount) amt
FROM d WHERE c>1 GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 0, 1, count(*), min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at), sum(net_amount) FROM d WHERE c=1 AND store_id=116

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE st.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date = DATE '2025-09-21' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f2 JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f2.store_key WHERE s2.store_id=116 AND f2.sale_date=DATE '2025-09-21' LIMIT 3) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id

SELECT 'ret_dups' k, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) c, sum(refund_net) d FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_dup_per_line', count(*), 0, 0, 0 FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) c FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'phys_stores', count(DISTINCT store_id), 0, 0, 0 FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zz_or_999_in_period_by_phys', count(*), 0, 0, sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pori_sales_in_closure', count(*), 0, 0, sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=119 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-08' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
